items.excerpt: Former South African Deputy President Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka has died at 71 JOHANNESBURG -- JOHANNESBURG (AP) — Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, South Africa's first female deputy president and a United Nations under-secretary-general, has died at age 71, the South African government announced Friday. Mlambo-Ngcuka, a former anti-apartheid activist and lawmaker in the South African Parliament, was deputy president from 2005 until 2008. She also served as minister of minerals and energy and deputy minister of trade and industry. She served as under-secretary-general and executive director of U.N. Women

items.title: Drivers limited to 27 laps for tyres in Qatar
items.description: Formula 1 drivers will be limited to a maximum of 27 laps on a set of tyres at next weekend's Qatar Grand Prix.
items.imageCaption: Image caption, Drivers were limited to 25 laps for each set of tyres in last year's Qatar Grand Prix
items.author: Andrew Benson
items.excerpt: Formula 1 drivers will be limited to a maximum of 27 laps on a set of tyres at next weekend's Qatar Grand Prix. The decision is caused by concern over the integrity of the Pirelli tyres on the high-speed Lusail track, which has a series of demanding, long-duration corners. It means teams will have to make at least two pit stops during the 57-lap grand prix, as was the case last year. The limit applies on a single set of tyres whenever it is used across sessions.
